title: 高三短对话：博物馆与押金
source_notice: 高三公开期末标签的五短对话两遍/十秒和已解示例已核；原音轨缺，印本注释脚本/键可核，原校地域学期正文未认证，“上学期2月”标题疑点保留。本稿完整原创配套非来源gold或独立难度验证。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听后留10秒。另有一个已解示例，示例录音在材料1开头，示范一次属本机编排，不计入五题。本机可重播供审阅，不作正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The museum closes at six. Would you like me to book the last entry at five?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That would only give us an hour. Let us go at three, so we can look around without rushing.

questions.stem: When does the woman want to enter the museum?
questions.rationale: A：明确改三点入馆；B：不愿只参观一小时；C：六点闭馆

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Your designs use very little water, which is helpful in this climate.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I choose plants that suit the area and group them by their needs. My clients spend less time watering their gardens that way.

questions.stem: What is the man most likely to be?
questions.rationale: A：没有游泳教学；B：不是播报天气；C：为客户选植物设计花园

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The bicycle hire is twenty pounds a day, isn't it?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, plus a refundable fifty-pound deposit. You pay both now and get the deposit back when you return it undamaged.

questions.stem: How much must the man pay now?
questions.rationale: A：只算租金漏押金；B：20加50等于70；C：只算押金漏租金

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Did you leave the lecture because you disagreed with the speaker?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not at all. I had arranged to meet a visiting colleague at the station, and her train was earlier than expected.

questions.stem: Why did the man leave early?
options: To meet someone arriving by train.
Because he disagreed with the speaker.
questions.rationale: A：明确接提前到的同事；B：未评价无聊；C：明确Not at all否认

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Would you rather work alone on the report?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: For the first draft, yes. But I want someone to challenge my argument afterwards. Otherwise I may miss a weakness I cannot see myself.

questions.stem: What does the woman value after writing a first draft?
questions.rationale: A：希望被挑战非回避；B：愿查弱点说明可能修订；C：明确希望他人挑战论点

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Shall we meet inside the library?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: It closes early today. Meet me outside the cafe instead.

question.rationale: A：图书馆提议被更改；B：明确改咖啡馆外；C：未提车站
